latest_release.name: v3.22.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
- Redis queue provider: choose LIST (default) or ZSET storage; ZSET uses `ZADD NX` + `ZPOPMIN` for atomic de-duplicated enqueue (#1447)
- Quarantine workflow instances that repeatedly fail to load instead of re-polling them forever (#1451, #1452)
- New package **WorkflowCore.AI**: `ChatClientStep` for calling any model through the Microsoft.Extensions.AI `IChatClient` abstraction (#1453)
- Flaky test fixes: sync-middleware test, EventOrderScenario event-ordering race, user-action snapshot retry (#1455), StopAsyncScenario timing (#1458)
- Fix unbounded completed-task retention in queue consumers (#1448, #1454)
- Bump version to 3.22.0 (#1460)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/danielgerlag/workflow-core/compare/v3.21.0...v3.22.0
